## D1-01 · Joined on the wrong column

> **GENERATED · written for this system (reinforces a concept from the source)**  
> Source: [lecture1 L1119-1132](../sources/lecture1.txt) *“I have to tell SQL which two columns to try to JOIN these tables by.”*, [lecture4 L207-219](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“linking it up by looking at the authors dot ID column”*

| Topic / concepts | Difficulty | Skills | Dataset | Task type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1.6 | ★★ |  | `longlist` | write a query |

This should return Fernanda Melchor's book titles, but the titles are wrong.

```sql
SELECT "title" FROM "authors"
JOIN "authored" ON "authors"."id" = "authored"."book_id"
JOIN "books" ON "books"."id" = "authored"."book_id"
WHERE "name" = 'Fernanda Melchor';
```

`join`
</details>
